items.name: Balloon
items.description: These promoted skeletons have traded in their joy of destroying walls for a joy of destroying defenses. Deploy them to take out pesky mortars and cannons!

items.name: Barbarian
items.description: This fearless warrior relies on his bulging muscles and striking mustache to wreak havoc in enemy villages. Release a horde of Barbarians and enjoy the mayhem!

superTroop.name: Super Barbarian
superTroop.description: Superior in health, power, speed and most importantly, hair, the Super Barbarians are what regular Barbarians dream of becoming!

items.name: Bowler
items.description: This big blue dude digs the simple things in life - Dark Elixir drinks and throwing rocks. His massive boulders bounce off of their target and hit again behind it for a double strike!

superTroop.name: Super Bowler
superTroop.description: Super Bowler now has everything he's ever wanted: a grippier glove, more comfortable footwear, and even more ridiculously massive boulders to toss.

items.name: Dragon Rider
items.description: This aerial engine of destruction readily and frankly, quite excitedly lays waste to any defense it comes across. The skeleton onboard swears he's not touching the controls.

items.name: Dragon
items.description: The might of the dragons is known throughout the land. This scaly terror of the skies feels no mercy and nothing will escape the fiery splashes of his breath.

superTroop.name: Super Dragon
superTroop.description: Sometimes having a fire inside of you isn't enough. The Super Dragon has fires on the inside, outside, and if he gets to do his thing, all around him!

items.name: Druid
items.description: The Druid has complicated emotions. One moment he's calmly helping heal his fellow Troops, and the next he's turned into a very angry Bear.

items.name: Electro Dragon
items.description: Possessing iron-tough scales and a breath of devastating lightning, the Electro Dragon's favorite thing is raining destruction from above. When vanquished, the Electro Dragon even pummels the ground with lightning strikes! (6 lightning bolts on death, each dealing the listed death damage to a random target.)

items.name: Electro Titan
items.description: Barely controlling her raw magical power, the Electro Titan is a formidable force on the battlefield. She channels some of her magic into a powerful electro whip while the rest spills out to damage everything around her.

items.name: Furnace
items.description: The Furnace doesn't move, but it does spawn Firemites over time that target Buildings. These curious little guys leave pools of fire where they visit!

items.name: Giant
items.description: These big guys may seem calm, but show them a Cannon or Archer Tower and you'll see their fury unleashed! Slow yet durable, these warriors are best used to soak up hits.

superTroop.name: Super Giant
superTroop.description: Super Giants are bigger than their ordinary cousins and are great at punching their way through walls. The belt is from the annual village eating contest.

items.name: Goblin
items.description: These pesky little creatures only have eyes for one thing: LOOT! They are faster than a Spring Trap, and their hunger for resources is limitless.

superTroop.name: Sneaky Goblin
superTroop.description: Sneaky Goblins have a talent going unnoticed for a while after being deployed. It's usually the incredibly loud sound of resources being pilfered that gives them away.

items.name: Golem
items.description: The mighty Golem loves to soak up damage! When destroyed, it explodes and splits into Golemites. The resulting Golemites have one-fifth the Golem's strength and hitpoints.

items.name: Headhunter
items.description: Headhunter has just one job: taking out enemy heroes. As her other job, she works at the village apothecary. She's lightweight enough to jump over walls and her poisoned weapons make her targets move and attack slower.

items.name: Hog Rider
items.description: Having tamed the fierce leaping hog, the Hog Rider punishes those who hide behind their puny walls! Fueled by Dark Elixir, these warriors have never known defeat!

superTroop.name: Super Hog Rider
superTroop.description: This dangerous duo of Hog and Rider are even more superb now. They ride together, they split up and keep fighting together.
